Topic 1.1: Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to 

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to . Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How have the teachings of the Enlightened Beings impacted society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state the contributions of the Enlightened Beings for harmonious living

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. state the contributions of the Enlightened Beings for harmonious living
   In simple words: practise until you can state the contributions of the Enlightened Beings for harmonious living. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  in the examples.
2. Explain Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to .
4. Show that you can: state the contributions of the Enlightened Beings for harmonious living

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Enlightened Beings contribution to mankind Tirthankars’ way of non- violence to  important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Conduct research using digital media/digital media with assistive technology libraries/ magazines to describe the contributions of Enlightened Beings
2. Listen to audio-visual clips on the life history of the Enlightened Beings
3. Digital Literacy: learner enhances digital skills when searching online to study Tridev’s contribution to mankind.
4. Respect: learner develops respect when writing an essay on The Guru’s way of life (Khalsa Panth) research on the concept of The Tirthankars’ way of non-violence (Ahimsa).
5. Responsibility: learner enhances resilience when developing a practical activity in implementing any of the teachings. 3 Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCI’s):

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How have the teachings of the Enlightened Beings impacted society?
2. How do the life histories of Enlightened Beings guide our lives today?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. state the contributions of the Enlightened Beings for harmonious living
